categories.name: أَسْمَاءُ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
categories.nameEn: Names of the Day of Judgment in the Quran

items.verse: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۗ وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حَدِيثًۭا
items.verseEn: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. He will surely assemble you for [account on] the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. And who is more truthful than Allāh in statement.

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
items.verseEn: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

categories.name: فِئَاتُ النَّاسِ بِحَسَبِ الإِيمَانِ فِي القُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Categories of People by Faith in the Quran

items.verse: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةًۭ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
items.verseEn: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers.

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ فِى ٱلدَّرْكِ ٱلْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
items.verseEn: Indeed, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire - and never will you find for them a helper -

items.verse: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.verseEn: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allāh after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allāh.
So let man observe from what he was created.
He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

categories.name: أَسْمَاءٌ عَلَى وَزْنِ تَفْعِيلٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Nouns of the Pattern Taf'il in the Quran

items.verseEn: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

items.verse: وَمَا كَانَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
items.verseEn: And it was not [possible] for this Qur’ān to be produced by other than Allāh, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds.
And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

harf.hint: The exclusive divine authority or ruling that belongs to none but Allah
harf.arabicVerse: مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءًۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
harf.verse: 12:40 - You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has sent down no evidence. Legislation is not but for Allāh. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

deduction.title: The Envy That Consumed
deduction.intro: A tale older than any kingdom or scripture—the first human tragedy born of jealousy. One soul, the elder of two children born to the first parents, watched in fury as a younger sibling received favor that was denied. What followed was the darkest of choices, leaving behind the first blood ever shed upon the earth. Can you uncover the identity, the trial, and the bitter regret?
clues: I was born of the very first pair of humans to walk the earth.
I once made an offering to Allah, but it was not accepted from me.
My sibling's offering was accepted, while mine was rejected—something I could not bear.
I threatened my own brother with destruction.
I became the first to commit murder upon this earth, taking the life of my own sibling.
Allah sent a creature of the earth—a black bird digging in the ground—to teach me how to conceal what I had done, and I was left with nothing but regret.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Abandoned as a baby in a river

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Became filled with regret and among the losers
Swallowed into the earth along with treasures
Became a noble messenger of Allah
outcome.answer: Became filled with regret and among the losers

deduction.arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
deduction.verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)

translations: towards Him the means and strive hard
scramble.hint: A powerful address to the believers combining three essential commands: taqwa (consciousness of Allah), drawing closer to Him through righteous deeds, and striving earnestly in His path — with the promise of ultimate success.
scramble.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
scramble.verseEn: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed.
